verdict.rationale: CrewAI supports building autonomous agent crews and event-driven Flows that run tasks and coordinate execution without manual step-by-step intervention, with deployment to managed infrastructure for background execution, kickoff/status APIs, and webhook streaming for monitoring. A community example (email triage crew) confirms real-world autonomous background-style automation. missing for 10: independent evidence of long-running/scheduled unattended background execution over extended periods, and third-party verification beyond one HN anecdote.
